section: cost
text: Two more costs follow from the design, though the paper does not discuss them ( beyond the paper; our reasoning ): a bidirectional prompt cache cannot be shared between requests that start with the same text, because every token's keys and values now depend on what comes after it, so serving engines' prefix caching ( vLLM's automatic prefix caching ) no longer applies to it; and LoRA can usually be merged into the base weights for free serving, while Bitune needs two different weight sets at prefill time, so it keeps one adapter live or holds two merged copies.
